title: dryopteris camptocaulon
intro: Dryopteris camptocaulon, commonly known as the Scaly Male-fern or Hairy Male Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which can help alleviate fever, pain, and swelling. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris camptocaulon include its use in treating respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions, making it a valuable medicinal plant in traditional medicine.
